title: Liouville theorems for $p$-Laplacian equations in convex cones without finite-energy condition
summary: We study the anisotropic Finsler $p$-Laplacian equation \begin{equation*} \left\{ \begin{aligned} &-Δ^{H}_{p}u=f(u) \quad\,\,\, &{\rm{in}} \,\, \mathcal{C}, &{\bf{a}}(\nabla u)\cdot ν=0 \quad\,\,\, &{\rm{on}} \,\, \partial\mathcal{C}, \end{aligned} \right. \end{equation*} where $N\geq3$, $1<p<N$, $\mathcal{C}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{N}$ is an open convex cone and $Δ^{H}_{p}$ is the anisotropic Finsler $p$-Laplacian operator.
